novelty.justification: The core novelty route is a new mechanistic relationship: the claim says that a "sparse set of attention heads acting as uncertainty detectors" writes a "'reconsider' signal into the residual stream," with the same circuit producing adaptive verification on hard problems and redundant loops on easy ones. Searches using "overthinking verification attention heads mechanistic interpretability," "self-doubt uncertainty-aware attention heads," and "reasoning backtracking circuit activation patching" found the closest work in Revisiting Overthinking in Long Chain-of-Thought from the Perspective of Self-Doubt (2025), which studies the behavior and prompting, RAUQ (2025), which identifies uncertainty-aware heads for hallucination detection, and Causal Head Gating (2025), which supplies general head-localization machinery, but none identifies heads causally gating self-verification onset. Moving from those works to a difficulty-modulated uncertainty-head circuit that explains both productive and maladaptive verification requires a new core relationship rather than a direct transfer, although the localization and intervention tools themselves are standard, supporting high but not paradigm-level novelty.
